title: The TV Police: A Rewatch of The Mentalist
author: The TV Police
description: Welcome to The TV Police, the ultimate rewatch podcast of The Mentalist. Hosted by original cast members Owain Yeoman (Rigsby) and Tim Kang (Cho), this series dives deep into every episode of the hit CBS TV series The Mentalist. Go behind the scenes with never-before-heard stories, character breakdowns, and insider moments with cast and crew. Whether you’re a long-time fan of Patrick Jane and Lisbon or discovering The Mentalist for the first time, The TV Police delivers laughs, nostalgia, and true TV insight. Follow now for weekly drops of exclusive commentary, unseen secrets, and authentic chemistry from Rigsby and Cho themselves.
